description: CamboJA reports an actual public CITA march toward Pursat on 1 February, but only around 30 activists gathered at Wat Phnom. The Ministry of Interior capped it at 50 people. Neither statement establishes 50 simultaneous participants; later route attendance is unknown.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous reports, organizer records or photographs that give a defensible local attendance count at the start or along the route; never infer from union membership or the 50-person cap.

description: The opened 1 February report documents only the first day of a planned 210-km Phnom Penh–Pursat march and does not describe its completion. A 2023 local-language follow-up is needed to establish later daily activity and the last action date.
required_followup: Search CamboJA/Khmer and permitted local sources for 2–10 February march progress, route, outcome and any cross-month continuation; keep end date unknown until explicit closure evidence.

description: Ten captured searches (239 rendered headers) cover English and Khmer general terms, labor/factory actions, NagaWorld, VOD closure and limited local outlet results. These searches found two actual public gathering leads and one employer-directed factory protest, but do not systematically cover all Cambodian provinces, sectors, or Khmer-local reporting. This is not exhaustive or a claim no other event occurred.
required_followup: Continue feasible Khmer and local English searches for February provincial, garment/labor, land/community, student, women’s, farmer, and public-sector actions; separately search CITA route follow-up and VOD crowd/demand evidence. Respect exact source holds.

description: RFA reports 'some 50' international media/civil-society members gathered outside VOD, but the approximation does not firmly establish a >=50 simultaneous count.
required_followup: Seek another permitted contemporaneous account with a defensible count of people present at this single gathering; do not count affiliated organizations or other sites.

description: The RFA story attributes a request that the government reconsider the closure to a VOD employee, but does not clearly establish that the gathered group made this demand or that the letter referred to was a protest petition.
required_followup: Find a permitted account clarifying the group’s action, letter contents and addressee. Do not infer state-targeted demand from solidarity alone.
